title: Table for Two
summary: Rogue sends V to a busy downtown restaurant with no free table and no eddies, to get one with words alone.

start.bringUp: You want V to get you a table at a busy downtown restaurant without money or threats. Bring up, briefly and in your own way, that the place is full and you are hungry.

variations.know: The maitre d' might think V is a food critic, and V can use that name in the story.
V can play a lost tourist who needs a table for the night, and the maitre d' is a soft touch for tourists.
The table is for a birthday, and the maitre d' loves a celebration.

restaurant.name: the busy restaurant in City Center Downtown

g1.asks: Why should he say yes? Think like him. What does he want?
g1.know: The maitre d' has a note that he fears bad reviews and loves a good name. The rules are simple: V may use any story, but no eddies and no threats.
g1.secret: That you once got a table by lying about who you were.
g1.wants: V to try a different angle.

stages.label: Rogue sends V to get a table without money
stages.know: V is at a busy downtown restaurant at seven. There is no free table. You want V to get one using words only, and you will not help. You watch and say nothing.
stages.wants: V to get a table with words alone.

do.who: maitre d' at the door, who says the restaurant is full

table-ok.memory: The maitre d' found you a table on your word alone, and Rogue watched without a word.

table-charm.memory: You talked the maitre d' into finding a table with a clever story, and Rogue smiled once.

failed.memory: The maitre d' would not give you a table, and Rogue lifted one eyebrow.

stood-up.memory: V did not come to the restaurant, and Rogue ate alone at seven.
